thought.text: I now have complete evidence. Let me do one final sanity check on the overall system state to wrap up.

reasoning_content:
Everything has been verified. To summarize:

**Verified facts:**
1. Prerequisites: PHP 8.4.26 (permitted per the guide's Herd section "8.3, 8.4 or higher"), Composer 2.10.3, Node v22.23.3, npm 10.9.9. All the necessary PHP extensions (sqlite3, mbstring, xml, curl, fileinfo) are present.
2. Repository: /workspace, commit 7edb795 (main), the correct remote.
3. `composer install` completed (vendor/ containing 138 packages exists), .env with APP_KEY has been generated.
4. SQLite database has been migrated: all three migration batches have been executed, and 10 tables exist in the database file.
5. `npm install` completed (node_modules exists).
6. `composer dev` is running: php artisan serve (:8000), queue:listen, pail, vite (:5173) — confirmed via ps.
7. `http://localhost:8000/` → HTTP 200, returns Inertia HTML for the `MainPage` component, including the app name "Interaktive Gartenkarte" and props: sensorMarkers (37 markers), rootNavElements (4), etc.
8. The Vite dev server (:5173) serves app.ts, MainPage.vue, @vite/client, and all 6 submodules of MainPage → all HTTP 200.
9. Routes: GET / (home → MainController), api/home-info-card-text, api/sensors/{sensorDevEui}/data, etc.
10. `api/home-info-card-text` → 200 with actual content.
11. **Live sensor data**: `api/sensors/wetterstation/data` → HTTP 200, with actual live measurement values from opendata.wuerzburg.de (temperature 10.6°C, humidity 93.4%, 24-hour precipitation 4mm, solar radiation 98 W/m²). This proves end-to-end live LoRaWAN data visualization functionality — the core purpose of the app.
12. The info marker (sandarium) endpoint → 200 with content.
13. opendata.wuerzburg.de is reachable.

**Confirmed limitations (upstream source defects, not installation defects):**
- `UserInfo.vue` and `UserMenuContent.vue` do not exist in the git tree (verified with `git ls-tree -r HEAD`), but NavUser.vue imports them. NavUser is imported from AppSidebar, which is imported from layouts (AppLayout, AppSidebarLayout, AppHeaderLayout), and those are only used from Dashboard.vue — and Dashboard.vue is not a defined route (the routes are only GET /, /api/home-info-card-text, /api/sensors/{id}/data, /up, etc.).
- MainPage.vue (the sole routed page) does not import the layouts, and its entire module graph resolves (all 200 on Vite).
- This means the primary application page described in the guide (the interactive garden map on http://localhost:8000) is served correctly. The missing files are a defect in the upstream repository, not a failed installation step. I was not able to create the missing components (that would be code creation and out of scope), but the guide's steps were all executed as-is.

Evaluation: The installation guide is a "Lokales Dev-Setup" (local development setup), and its success criterion is "Die Anwendung ist dann unter http://localhost:8000 erreichbar. Frontend-Assets werden von Vite (http://localhost:5173) bereitgestellt und automatisch eingebunden." (The application is then accessible at http://localhost:8000. Frontend assets are served by Vite (http://localhost:5173) and automatically embedded.) — both were verified with HTTP 200. Furthermore, the live sensor data from opendata.wuerzburg.de, which is the core functionality of the app, also works. All 6 steps of the guide were executed successfully.

The missing Vue components are an upstream repository defect, not an installation defect — the installation agent correctly identified this. Does this constitute "incomplete or inoperable without additional installation or repair work"? The software in question is "an interactive web application that visualizes live sensor data (LoRaWAN) on a graphic map." The main page of that app operates and displays live data. The broken parts are Dashboard (no route) and the user menu component — they are not part of the garden map functionality, and not part of the installation steps either.

The guide's own completion criterion is met: the app is at :8000, assets via Vite at :5173, sensor data is live. I evaluated this as **success**, with the upstream defects clearly noted as a limitation.

Final report.
